title: Deck
description: A deck: what a `.deck` file holds.

Size.description: Width and height in slide units (1/96 inch).

master.description: Elements drawn on every slide, under its own: a header bar, a logo, a slide number.

dimmedOpacity.description: Opacity of a dimmed element, 0 to 1.

Colors.description: The twelve colours a theme names. They map one for one to PPTX theme colours.

FontSpec.description: A typeface and what to fall back on when it is missing.

TextStyle.description: One of the named looks for text: `title`, `subtitle`, `body`, `caption`, `code`, `citation`.

name.description: The name a slide refers to: `title`, `title-body`, `two-columns`, ...

hideMaster.description: Leave out the master elements on slides of this layout.

PlaceholderDef.description: A slot on a layout that an element can fill.

style.description: The text style it starts from.

list.description: Set as a list when filled.

prompt.description: What the empty slot asks for, such as "Click to add title".

Style.description: Everything about an element's looks that is not its text.

radius.description: Corner radius of a rounded shape, in slide units.

Shadow.description: A soft shadow behind an element.

StepState.description: How an element looks from a step onward, until the next change.

oneOf.description: Shown faded, at the theme's dimmed opacity.
As styled, with the theme's highlight around it.

Text.description: The text of a text box, a shape, a table cell or a label.

Paragraph.description: A paragraph: runs and how they are set.

level.description: Indent level of a list item, from 0.

style.description:
The theme text style the paragraph starts from: `title`,
`subtitle`, `body`, `caption`, `code` or `citation`.

lineSpacing.description: A multiple of the line height, such as 1.15.

step.description: The step at which this paragraph appears, for lists that build line by line.

Run.description: A stretch of text with one look.

color.description: A theme token or `#rrggbb`; the paragraph's style when absent.

link.description: A web address, or `slide:<id>` for a link to a slide.

code.description: Inline code: drawn in the code font.

field.description: A field the text stands for, such as `slideNumber`; `t` is its sample.

Insets.description: Space between a box's edge and its text, in slide units.

id.description: Unique on its slide. Two slides may share an id on purpose: that is how Morph pairs elements. Left out when adding an element, it is assigned.

x.description: Left edge in slide units. Absent when a placeholder supplies the box.

placeholder.description: The layout slot this element fills: `title`, `body`, `image`, ...

stepStates.description: The state from each step onward.

name.description: The layer's name in the Steps panel and the selection list.

alt.description: What a person who cannot see the element is told.

morphId.description: Pairs this element with one of another id in a Morph.
